stories.title: Anthony Edwards Knee Surgery — Timberwolves Lose Star for Up to 2 Months [TIER 1]

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
BREAKING: Anthony Edwards is out up to TWO MONTHS for knee surgery.

He scored 47 points Monday. Two days later, this.

The Timberwolves lose their franchise player until December. #Timberwolves #NBA

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Ant Edwards: 47 points Monday. Knee surgery announced Tuesday.

Same right knee as last season. Out until December.

Minnesota was 3-1. Now what? #Timberwolves

facebook.long_form:
Posting Window: 9:00 AM ET

BREAKING: Anthony Edwards is heading into knee surgery and will be sidelined for up to TWO MONTHS.

The 25-year-old Timberwolves star will undergo an arthroscopic procedure on his right knee — the same knee that cost him significant time last season. The Timberwolves expect to have him back sometime in December.

Here's what makes this so painful: Edwards scored 47 POINTS in Monday's overtime loss to Cleveland. Two days later, the announcement came.

Minnesota was 3-1 and looking like a legitimate contender. Now they face a real test — can the supporting cast hold things together while Ant is out?

The Edwards knee issue has been recurring. He dealt with patellofemoral pain syndrome last season, missing 11 of the final 14 regular-season games. This time, the team opted for surgery to address it properly.

The NBA is a different game without Anthony Edwards on the floor.

Drop a 🏀 if you're a Wolves fan. How do you think Minnesota handles this?
facebook.image_caption: Anthony Edwards will miss up to two months with a right knee procedure. He dropped 47 points just two days before the announcement. 💔 #Timberwolves #NBA

stories.title: Trail Blazers 136, Lakers 129 — Dončić 41, Portland Stays Perfect [TIER 1]

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Battle of unbeatens: Portland wins.

Trail Blazers 136, Lakers 129. Luka Dončić dropped 41 — still not enough.

Portland stays perfect. LA's unbeaten streak is over. #TrailBlazers #Lakers

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Luka Dončić: 41 points. Portland Trail Blazers: still unbeaten.

Sometimes 41 just isn't enough. Portland is for real. #Lakers #TrailBlazers

facebook.long_form:
Posting Window: 9:00 AM ET

Luka Dončić put up 41 POINTS last night.

It still wasn't enough.

The Portland Trail Blazers beat the Los Angeles Lakers 136-129 Tuesday night in a battle of two previously unbeaten teams. Deni Avdija and Portland's balanced offense overwhelmed LA's defense when it mattered most.

Dončić is doing what Dončić does — putting up legendary numbers night in and night out. But the Lakers couldn't get enough from anyone else to keep pace with a Portland squad that is playing complete basketball on both ends.

Portland is now the West's last unbeaten team. The Lakers had looked like one of the best teams in the conference through their early games, but this loss is a reality check.

Who do you think goes further this season — Portland or LA? 👇
facebook.image_caption: Portland 136, LA 129. Luka posted 41 and still lost. The Blazers are for real. 🔥 #TrailBlazers #Lakers

stories.title: Celtics 125, Nets 124 OT — Tatum's Buzzer-Beater Caps 40-Point Night [TIER 1]

x_posts.label: Post 3-1

Jayson Tatum. 40 points. BUZZER-BEATER in overtime.

Celtics 125, Nets 124. Boston wins their third straight. Tatum is locked in. #Celtics

x_posts.label: Post 3-2
x_posts.text:
Brooklyn Nets: 0-4.

They led late. Tatum hit the buzzer-beater to end it.

The Nets are in serious trouble early. #Nets #NBA

facebook.long_form:
Posting Window: 9:00 AM ET

JAYSON TATUM IS THAT GUY. 🍀

40 points. Overtime. BUZZER-BEATER.

Tatum's jumper at the buzzer in overtime gave Boston a 125-124 win over Brooklyn Tuesday night — the kind of shot that gets replayed for years.

The Celtics are now 3-0 after three consecutive wins. Tatum has been absolutely brilliant, and last night he delivered when it counted most.

Brooklyn tried everything. Michael Porter Jr. battled with 27 points. But in the end, Tatum hit the shot that ended it.

The Nets fall to 0-4 and are in trouble early. Meanwhile, Boston looks like a team that wants to get back to the Finals.

What do you think: Is Jayson Tatum the best player in the Eastern Conference right now?

stories.title: Knicks 111, Pistons 97 — KAT 27/20, Detroit's First Loss [TIER 2]

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Karl-Anthony Towns: 27 points. 20 rebounds.

Knicks 111, Pistons 97. New York gets their first W. Detroit's unbeaten start is over.

KAT looked like himself last night. #Knicks

facebook.long_form:
Posting Window: 11:00 AM ET

Karl-Anthony Towns reminded everyone why he's one of the best big men in the game.

KAT dropped 27 POINTS and grabbed 20 REBOUNDS as the New York Knicks beat the Detroit Pistons 111-97 Tuesday night at Madison Square Garden. It was the Knicks' first win of the season — and the Pistons' first loss.

Jalen Brunson added 23 points as New York looked sharp in the second half, outscoring Detroit 37-13 in the third quarter to blow the game open.

The Pistons had been one of the surprise stories of the early season — unbeaten and playing with confidence. Tuesday night, the Knicks showed them what an elite front-office building looks like at full tilt.

Do you think the Knicks can make a run this season with KAT and Brunson healthy?
facebook.image_caption: KAT: 27 pts, 20 reb. Knicks first W of the year. Pistons first L. The Garden was loud last night. 🗽 #Knicks #NBA

🔮 Orlando Magic vs. Toronto Raptors — 7:30 PM ET

And then Thursday, the NBA CUP officially tips off. Starting October 30, select games count toward the NBA Cup standings — adding extra stakes to what's already a highly competitive early season.
